We have three tasks to cover between 0800 and 1200: airfield fuel sampling, radio-cable inspection, and clinic-generator testing. We have three support teams available—Red, Blue, and Gold. I need to hear from airfield operations, signal, and medical planning before I make the assignments. Who'd like to start?
